VALIDATION: Some fields are missing or invalid.
TOTP_REQUIRED: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TOTP_INVALID: That code is not valid. Try the latest code.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you do not have access.
STALE_VERSION: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.
INVALID_TRANSITION: This move is not allowed from the current stage.
CLOSE_REASON_REQUIRED: Choose a reason before closing this deal.
CLOSE_REASON_INVALID: That reason does not apply to this outcome.
WIN_REQUIRES_QUOTE: A deal is won by accepting its quote, with a win reason.
REOPEN_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for reopening this deal.
CURRENCY_MISMATCH: USD and KHR cannot be combined without an exchange rate.
CONFLICT: This conflicts with an existing record.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. The team has been notified.
QUOTE_LOCKED: This quote has been sent and can no longer change. Revise it to make a new version.
QUOTE_EMPTY: Add at least one line before submitting.
MARGIN_BELOW_FLOOR: The margin is below the floor. Finance or Ops must approve before it can be sent.
FX_RATE_MISSING: No exchange rate from the last 5 days. Ask Finance to enter today's rate.
SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own request.
ALREADY_DECIDED: This request was already decided or replaced.
DECIDE_IN_APP: This decision must be made in the DemoQ app, not from chat.
STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Confirm with your 6-digit code to approve this.
WIN_REASON_REQUIRED: Choose why we won before accepting the quote.
CHANGE_ORDER_NOT_ADDITIVE: Change orders can only add work. Reductions are a Finance credit.
GATE_BLOCKED: Work can't start yet: some project gates are still missing.
GATE_EXEMPTION_REQUIRED: Only a recorded Finance or Ops exemption can waive the PO gate.
BYPASS_INVALID: A bypass needs a named owner, a reason of at least 30 characters and an expiry within 30 days.
TASK_INCOMPLETE: A task needs one owner, an estimate and a due date.
OUT_OF_SCOPE_REQUIRED: This task isn't in the scope. Link it to a scope item, mark it non-deliverable, or request an out-of-scope decision.
DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: That dependency would create a loop.
DEPENDENCY_OPEN: Finish the tasks this one depends on first.
